title: Simulating and Analyzing Order Book Data: The Queue-Reactive Model
supported_mechanism_claims: Conditional intensities of limit-order, cancellation, and trade-related book events can depend on the state of queues in a queue-reactive model.
Book-event dynamics and transition behavior can be modeled without inferring the identities or intentions of individual liquidity providers.
scope_note: Research model/general setting, not an empirically verified BTCUSDT signal or passive-fill model.
